persona: Mid-level SOA Suite and OSB developer who has not yet worked on OIC
resumeText:
Pradeep Nair | Bengaluru | pradeep.nair@example.com

SUMMARY
Oracle SOA developer with 6 years building integrations for telecom and retail clients on SOA Suite 12c and OSB.

EXPERIENCE
Oracle SOA Developer, Kaveri Integration Labs, Bengaluru (2020 - present)
- Built BPEL and Mediator composites in Oracle SOA Suite 12c with DB, File and FTP adapters for order-to-cash flows.
- Developed OSB proxy services and business services with XQuery transformations for 30 partner APIs.
- Wrote XSLT maps and XSD schemas and handled SOAP faults with fault policies.
- Exposed REST APIs from OSB for the mobile app team and consumed partner REST services.
- Deployed composites to WebLogic clusters and configured JMS queues and data sources.
- Wrote SQL queries on Oracle staging tables to reconcile failed orders.

Software Engineer, Tranquil Systems, Kochi (2018 - 2020)
- Wrote PL/SQL packages for nightly billing batch jobs.
- Monitored failed instances in Enterprise Manager and fixed production integration errors.

SKILLS
Oracle SOA Suite, OSB, BPEL, WebLogic, SQL, PL/SQL, Java, Maven

EDUCATION
BTech Computer Science, Cochin University of Science and Technology, 2018
